story: Eight fixed peaks are restored by descending measured intensity while 46 other peaks remain present.
selection_rule: Descending original measured intensity; independent of both model outcomes.
guardrails: The add-back filmstrip is one model-independent path through the exhaustive 256-coalition set.
Only the intensity order is model-independent; the fixed eight-peak set is conditioned on the frozen DreaMS error isomer used to define the case.
Non-support peaks and precursor metadata remain present in every coalition.
Displayed spectra retain one fixed original intensity scale; model effects include deletion and native intensity renormalization applied during scoring.
The frozen isomer is the original DreaMS top-1 error for this case, not a population decoy definition.
MAGMa fragment structures are candidate interpretations.
This is a deterministic single-case stress test, not population or causal evidence.
